shots.intent: 搜索列表一秒点击，用白底无痕正面廓形完成合规主图任务。
一图承托核心主张，让软支撑条与波浪下摆的受力方向一眼可读。
用后视结构交代宽带走向、背扣排布与可拆背扣片，替买家消除合体疑虑。
让买家在有限颜色与前扣款式之间自选，色值全部固定不漂移。
微距交代织纹与热熔边做工，用质感本身自证品质。
保留双栏对照结构，两侧主张全部留白，只谈本品版型而不指向任何真实竞品。
用空白参数行与留空表格单元承接尺码信息，把选码这一步交回卖家事实。
收口促单，用两件组合与一枚留空按钮把已建立的好感落成点击。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft blush-beige #F5EBE6 for benefit and closing screens, cool studio grey #E8E5E1 for structure and comparison screens; no location backgrounds, no prop walls, no fabric-drape sets
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms drawn in the accent tone inside white circular mask crops; one continuous stroke, no filled shapes, no 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: bright even neutral studio light, large soft key from upper left at about 5600K with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle wrap contact shadow under the hem band, low contrast, matte fabric surface with visible knit texture, never over-smoothed
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent minimal intimates catalogue visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, soft blush-beige #F5EBE6, cool studio grey #E8E5E1 and exactly one lotus-pink accent #C98F86 keyed to the product; bright even neutral studio light with a large soft key from upper left at about 5600K, a fill card on the shadow side and a gentle wrap contact shadow under the hem band; matte seamless sweep and neutral matte board surfaces only, never a reflective tabletop; modern geometric sans-serif typography with all copy held as empty callout bars, blank chips and empty table cells; thin single-weight line pictograms inside white circular mask crops; the garment presented only flat on a surface, on an invisible ghost form, or as a tight detail crop with cup shape, neckline edge, strap geometry, hook-and-eye rows and wave-edged hem band never redrawn; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no watermarks or QR codes.
noDrift: no brand wordmarks or store badges
style.presentationRules: the garment is always shown as a standalone object: laid flat on a surface, held on an invisible ghost form, or as a tight detail crop; cup shape, neckline edge, strap geometry, hook-and-eye rows and the wave-edged hem band are never redrawn; identical scale and centered placement across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless white sweep and neutral matte board, no reflective tabletop, no water or glass surface
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; every piece of source on-image copy is stripped to empty callout bars, blank chips and empty table cells, so no lettering is ever rendered
